title: A Systematic Analysis of Live Intraoperative Surgical Expert Narrations
abstract: arXiv:2611.00028v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Manual annotation remains the principal bottleneck in surgical video understanding. Live intraoperative narration by the operating surgeon is a scalable alternative that requires no manual annotation, but the information it contains has not been characterized. We analyzed 13 endoscopic lumbar spine decompression procedures (13.2 h) by two senior spine surgeons, using time-synchronized close-mic German audio. An annotation-free pipeline (word-level speech recognition, deterministic correction of surgical-term errors, utterance fusion, LLM-based translation to English, and relevance filtering) converted speech into time-stamped procedural cues labelled with the surgical entities they reference and their speech act. Of 3,171 utterances, 1,201 (37.9%) were retained as procedural cues, while 57.6% were non-procedural and removed. translated_title: 术中手术专家实时解说内容的系统性分析
translated_abstract: 人工标注仍然是手术视频理解中的主要瓶颈。由主刀外科医生进行的术中实时解说是一种无需人工标注的可扩展替代方案，但其包含的信息尚未被系统刻画。我们分析了两位资深脊柱外科医生实施的13例内镜下腰椎减压手术（共13.2小时），使用时间同步的近讲麦克风德语音频。通过一条无需标注的处理流程（词级语音识别、手术术语错误的确定性纠正、语句融合、基于大语言模型的英文翻译以及相关性过滤），将语音转换为带时间戳的手术流程提示，并标注其所指的手术实体及言语行为类型。在3,171条语句中，1,201条（37.9%）被保留为手术流程提示，57.6%属于非手术内容而被移除。保留的提示涉及手术器械（60.7%）、解剖结构（48.0%）和手术动作（57.1%），98.5%至少携带（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究首次系统刻画了脊柱外科医生术中实时解说所包含的信息，并提出一条无需人工标注的自动化语音处理流程，可将术中解说转换为带时间戳的手术流程提示，为手术视频理解提供了一种可扩展的替代标注方案。
en_tdlr: This study systematically characterizes the information contained in live intraoperative narrations by spine surgeons and introduces an annotation-free pipeline that converts intraoperative speech into time-stamped procedural cues, providing a scalable alternative to manual annotation for surgical video understanding.
